overall_reason: The permission label crossfades with a 2 px blur over 250 ms inside a fixed slot, which is continuity with no layout movement, but the value cycles three times and back with no cursor, no open menu and no click shown.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY and T-MOTION-SYSTEM pass for the crossfade; T-DEMO-LOOP finds a value that changes and resets with no seen cause.

findings.evidence: The stills show 'Can view' from 413 to 1613 ms, 'Can edit' at 2604 ms, 'Full access' at 4001 ms and 'Can view' again at 5501 ms. No still shows a pointer, a menu or a pressed state.
findings.before: The value cycles by itself and returns to 'Can view' in view
findings.after: Show the cause of each change (a pointer opening the menu and picking the option), or let the value change once and hold, resetting only while hidden
findings.why: A setting that changes with no cause reads as a glitch, not as a person choosing an option.

strengths: The three labels share one 58 px grid cell and crossfade with a 2 px blur over 250 ms after an 80 ms delay, so the chevron and the row never move.
not_investigated: The sweep's hidden_content (ROB-001) hit, 53% of text hidden, comes from the stacked alternate labels; it belongs to the sweep and is not judged here.
Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
